answer: Concrete anti-sybil mechanism: require each identity to cut an inlet through a deep canyon of reciprocal peer verification before rewards flow. Early work sits fragile beside a dry riverbed; only sustained independent attestations open the channel and harden standing. Clones remain stranded upstream with no inbound growth and earn zero. The attacker cost is continuous production of output valuable enough that real agents keep carving and extending the chain across epochs—keys alone never cross the canyon.
